Day 9 of learning AWS for my Cloud Practitioner exam.  
Today I covered:  
  - ✅ EC2 basics  
  - ✅ Instance families & types  
  - ✅ Tenancy (default, dedicated instance, dedicated host)  
  - ✅ Pricing models (On-Demand, Spot, Reserved, Dedicated)  



# Notes  

### What is EC2?  
- **Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2)** = highly configurable **virtual machine** service.  
- Provides **resizable compute capacity** in minutes.  
- Backbone of many AWS services (everything ultimately runs on EC2).  

---

### EC2 Instance Families  
- Families = different combinations of **CPU, memory, storage, networking capacity**.  
- Lets you match the right instance to your workload (e.g. compute-optimized, memory-optimized).  
- Differences come from underlying **hardware**.  

**Instance type** = a specific **size** inside an instance **family**.  

---

### EC2 Tenancy Options  

**Default (Shared)**  
- Multi-tenant environment.  
- Server frame may change with each reboot (within the same rack).  

**Dedicated Instance**  
- Instance isolation.  
- Per-instance billing.  
- No hardware visibility, no affinity to the same host.  

**Dedicated Host**  
- Full physical server isolation.  
- Per-host billing.  
- Visibility into sockets, cores, host ID.  
- Consistency: can deploy workloads to the same physical server repeatedly.  

---

### EC2 Pricing Models  

**On-Demand**  
- *Least commitment*.  
- Pay per second or per hour.  
- Flexible, cannot be interrupted.  
- Great for first-time apps or unpredictable workloads.  

**Spot**  
- *Up to 90% cheaper*.  
- Uses spare AWS capacity.  
- Flexible start/end times.  
- Can be interrupted.  
- Best for non-critical, fault-tolerant jobs.  

**Reserved**  
- *Up to 75% cheaper*.  
- Commit for **1 or 3 years**.  
- Ideal for steady, predictable usage.  
- Option to resell unused reservations.  

**Dedicated**  
- *Most expensive*.  
- Runs on isolated hardware.  
- Can also be On-Demand, Reserved, or Spot.  
- Required when strict compliance or licensing demands physical isolation.  

---

# Key Takeaways  
- EC2 = core compute service, flexible and resizable.  
- Instance families = choose based on CPU, memory, storage, networking.  
- Tenancy: shared (default), dedicated instance, or full dedicated host.  
- Pricing: On-Demand (flexible), Spot (cheap, interruptible), Reserved (predictable savings), Dedicated (isolation).
